revision_policy: Existing local sources are pinned to the supplied immutable baseline and exact SHA-256. Newly authored inputs have content-addressed source revisions; their Git commit is assigned when the stack publishes this change. No historical source revision or license is invented.

execution.grouping: Entries sharing an identical argv/cwd execute once; all their theorems and certificate guards are elaborated in that module.
execution.measurement_policy: Correctness/availability checks only. No normalizer-versus-grind timings, no production pipeline measurements, no proof traces.
